business_problem: Nexon was working across fragmented service tools that limited visibility, slowed onboarding and support, and made it harder for agents to deliver proactive customer care.
solution_summary: Nexon was working across fragmented service tools that limited visibility, slowed onboarding and support, and made it harder for agents to deliver proactive customer care. Nexon Asia Pacific implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, Customer Service Management, Virtual Agent, and Predictive Intelligence. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; Customer Service Management manages customer-support cases and self-service; Virtual Agent handles conversational self-service; Predictive Intelligence classifies and routes work. Requests enter through Virtual Agent, are classified or summarized by Predictive Intelligence, and uses context from Knowledge Base before ServiceNow AI Platform and Customer Service Management routes or fulfills the work. Updates then flow back to agents, account teams, or customers through the same connected experience.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow AI Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the common workflow and AI platform that unifies service data, automation, and user experiences.

solution_components.name: Customer Service Management
solution_components.role: Coordinates customer-support cases, self-service, and agent work on one platform.

solution_components.name: Virtual Agent
solution_components.role: Handles conversational self-service and ticket deflection for users.

solution_components.name: Predictive Intelligence
solution_components.role: Classifies, routes, and prioritizes work using machine-learning models.

solution_components.name: Knowledge Base
solution_components.role: Stores reusable knowledge content that search and assistants reference during support.
